fields.Name: IT144 - SQL Pipeline Extraction Fixtures
fields.Description: Forty fixture queries (EF01–EF40), each with hand-written expected metadata on SQL Server and PostgreSQL, saved with extraction on and compared exactly: parameter rows (name, type, required, default, description), field rows in order (base and full type per platform, nullability on SQL Server, computed, source as a mock-schema object, an MJ entity field, or none), Query Entities and Query Dependencies (path, alias, argument mapping). Cases: every column type of a mock table; a view over a view; aliases; computed expressions (decimal scale, cast, functions); aggregates; LEFT JOIN nullability; names with spaces; a table-valued / set-returning function (PostgreSQL results carry no source or length); CTEs, recursive CTEs, UNION ALL, VALUES, window functions, DISTINCT / derived / EXISTS, own caps; SQL Server-only TRY_CAST, FOR JSON, STRING_AGG with OPTION, TOP PERCENT WITH TIES (skipped on PostgreSQL); required / optional / defaulted parameters, header and trailing doc comments, arrays, dates and booleans, set variables and Context tokens, one parameter in if / elif / outside, .length guards and inline if, branch-only columns; static, pass-through (inherited type and description), arithmetic and Context-token composition arguments; core user / role views with entity field binding, entities read only in a CTE, an IN subquery or an EXISTS, a CTE named like an entity view. Builds and drops the mock schema mjit_sqlpipe and a per-run zzz-it144 category.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Extraction writes exactly the hand-written expected metadata for every fixture query.
